title: Losing stars with every wash...
text:
Losing stars with every wash.... Update: 12 Sept 2019 after first wash this blanket is covered in pills and the edging is falling off. I'm afraid if I wash it again the edging will come completely off.

Feels a little sub-par on the quality. Afraid to wash it for fear it will fall apart. But really soft and pretty.
